contexts.text: Abraham ran to the herd () = natural good... from the signification of oxen and bullocks, which belong to the herd. Explained. AC 2180:2.
Butter of the herd () = the Celestial Natural.
Herd = exterior or natural good. AC 4378. AC 4505.
The natural good which is signified by herd is not that which is born with man, but it is that which is acquired by means of Knowledges of truth joined to affections of good. Explained.
He halved the... herd... into two camps () = the preparation and disposing of the... goods in the Natural to receive the good represented by Esau.... Herd = exterior goods, and also non-goods.
His herds () = the exercises of charity... Herds = the exterior goods of charity, thus its exercises...
The reason herds = external goods, was that to herds belong oxen, bullocks, and calves, by which are signified such things as are of the good and truth in the external man. References. AC 9391.
Herds, which consist of calves, bullocks, cows, and oxen, = exterior goods and truths, which are natural truths and goods. References.
Herds = the natural things with man... or those of the natural mind.
Herds, which are bullocks, oxen, cows, and camels, = natural things from spiritual ones.
Herd = all the natural things with man which correspond to spiritual ones.
